Options:

 -s, --scope <SCOPE> Initial scope: unstaged, staged, or both [default: both]
 --unstaged Show unstaged changes
 --staged Show staged changes
 --both Show all working-tree changes
 --commits Start on the branch's oldest commit
 -h, --help Print help"
